min_age.description: Minimum age the end user must meet.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum model confidence to accept an estimate without a step-up.

buffer.description: Age band (in years) around `min_age` that triggers a step-up instead of an immediate decision. Must not exceed `min_age`. Applies to the AI estimate only, never to a document-derived age.

escalation.description: Action when the estimate is uncertain. `DOC` = document step-up; `NONE` = resolve as `UNCERTAIN`.

retry_limit.description: Max estimation attempts before the session locks.

save_photo.description: Whether the analysed selfie is stored for sessions from this token.

expiry_minutes.description: Token validity window in minutes from creation.

success_redirect.description: Redirect after a `SUCCESS` outcome (blank = built-in result screen).

webhook_url.description: Per-session override for where the result notification is sent. Blank = use your account's default Age Estimation webhook notification.

client_id.description: Your own identifier for the end user; echoed back in the result webhook for correlation.
